question: On eight fixed synthetic semantic-ray RuleSets where the prior root screen showed 5/8 D1 action changes, does static-v2 candidate-vs-Unit play show a directional outcome signal?
changed_premise: Exact privately retained root screen: 8/8 accepted and legal; static-v2 board-only changes the D1 root action in five fixed rules; no outcomes have been measured.

slots.start: same fresh initial state and deterministic exposed-ray RuleSet as prior root screen

candidate: static-v2 rule-derived board values only; hand 900/non-anchor; promotion gains 0
opponent: Unit board 1000/non-anchor, 0 anchor; hand 900/non-anchor; promotion gains 0

fixed.search: AlphaBetaPlayer; D2; max_nodes=20000 per move; no wall-clock; qdepth/hard/qnodes=0; TT/order/native semantic legality/root tactical all off

censoring.incomplete_depth: UNKNOWN, stop game, retain partial event, no fallback submission

measurements: resolved score overall and by color/ruleset
candidate vs opponent per-move median and total nodes
decision_rule: Exploratory only. A follow-up is justified only if all 16 slots resolve without failure, candidate score >0.5, no ruleset loses both color-swapped games, and candidate median move nodes <= opponent median. Otherwise close this candidate screen. No outcome changes product defaults.
exclusions: no claim of general strength or population effect
scope: Fixed 8-rule/16-game bounded follow-up; expected under 120 minutes.
